results.question: average agreed price of completed bike sales in 2025

results.question: which meetup spot got the most new listings in spring 2026?

results.question: for each category, how many days on average does it take an item to sell?
results.sql:
SELECT la.category,
       ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM d.completed_at - la.listed_at) / 86400)::numeric, 2) AS avg_days_to_sell
FROM nlq.deals d
JOIN nlq.listings_all la ON d.item_id = la.item_id
WHERE d.deal_type = 'sale'
  AND d.status = 'completed'
  AND d.completed_at IS NOT NULL
  AND la.listed_at IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY la.category
ORDER BY la.category;
results.answer: Across all time, the average days to sell vary by category: bikes_transport takes 11.20 days, clothing 11.32 days, dorm_essentials 11.39 days, electronics 11.40 days, furniture 11.61 days, kitchen 11.49 days, other 12.08 days, sports_outdoors 11.56 days, and textbooks 11.56 days.

results.question: what share of conversations led to a request, by meetup spot?

       COUNT(*) AS total_conversations,
       SUM(CASE WHEN c.led_to_request THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS conversations_led_to_request,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN c.led_to_request THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0), 2) AS share_percent
FROM nlq.conversations c
JOIN nlq.listings_all la ON c.item_id = la.item_id
JOIN nlq.meetup_spots ms ON la.spot_id = ms.spot_id
GROUP BY ms.name
ORDER BY ms.name;

results.question: late-return rate for rentals due during finals compared with rentals due during regular classes
results.sql:
SELECT
  c.period,
  COUNT(*) AS total_rentals,
  SUM(CASE WHEN d.returned_late THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS late_returns,
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN d.returned_late THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0), 2) AS late_return_rate_percent
FROM nlq.deals d
JOIN nlq.calendar c ON d.rental_due_date = c.day
WHERE d.deal_type = 'rental'
  AND d.rental_returned_at IS NOT NULL
  AND c.period IN ('finals', 'classes')
GROUP BY c.period
ORDER BY c.period;
results.answer: During regular classes there were 2,742 rentals, with 539 returned late for a 19.66% late‑return rate. During finals there were 134 rentals, with 25 returned late for an 18.66% rate.

results.question: which category has the highest sell-through rate?
results.sql:
SELECT c.category, c.label, ROUND(100.0 * sold_count::numeric / total_count, 2) AS sell_through_percent
FROM (
  SELECT category,
         COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'sold') AS sold_count,
         COUNT(*) AS total_count
  FROM nlq.listings_all
  WHERE is_for_sale = true
  GROUP BY category
) sub
JOIN nlq.categories c ON sub.category = c.category
WHERE total_count > 0
ORDER BY sell_through_percent DESC
LIMIT 1;
results.answer: The Dorm essentials category has the highest sell‑through rate at 63.21%. This figure covers all time.
